items.note: CHI 2025 study comparing three LLM-use conditions on problem reframing; abstract not reachable (API calls stalled), so N=280 and design come from search notes only.
Technovation paper on task breadth and cognitive flexibility in GenAI-supported idea generation; abstract not reachable, kept as experiment by default for full-text check.
Three studies of more than 880,000 texts tracking linguistic diversity in the LLM era plus LLM rewrites (arXiv 2502.11266 is the preprint); abstract not reachable, classified from search notes.
Technovation paper on GenAI collaboration modes and employee innovation; abstract not reachable, design unknown (may be survey or observational, outcomes may be self-reported).

Pre-registered online RCT giving researchers AI suggestions for their ideas (N=310 plus 28 follow-up per notes); title stresses perceptions of ideas, so outcomes may be self-reported; SSRN version likely earlier; abstract not reachable.
Engineering-education study of AI-assisted design synthesis and student creativity; abstract not reachable, comparison condition and N unknown.
Neuroimaging study comparing human-human with human-AI collaborative engineering design; abstract not reachable, likely small sample and neural outcomes.

Preregistered experiment where university students solve creative problems with ChatGPT (77) or without (68), with rated solution quality; preprint at OSF 9z2tc; abstract not reachable here, N from search notes.
Meta-analysis of 106 experiments on human-AI combinations, covering AI broadly; reports creation tasks as a subgroup, so relevant as context synthesis; abstract not reachable.
CUI 2026 study of negotiating a creative task with AI, measuring self-efficacy and task performance; N=28 per notes (below 50); abstract not reachable.
